ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution, Government of India

key_enforcement_sections.title: Provisions regarding packaged commodities
key_enforcement_sections.description: No person shall manufacture, pack, sell, distribute, deliver, offer, expose or possess for sale any pre-packaged commodity unless it bears declarations and markings in prescribed manner.

key_enforcement_sections.title: Penalty for manufacture, sale, etc., of non-standard packages
Penalty for sale of pre-packaged commodity in non-compliance with rules

enactments.title: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
mandatory_declarations: Rule 6(1)(a): Name and complete address of the manufacturer / packer / importer
Rule 6(1)(b): Common or generic name of commodity & Net Quantity in standard SI units
Rule 6(1)(c): Maximum Retail Price (MRP) inclusive of all taxes, Unit Sale Price (USP)
Rule 6(1)(d): Month and year in which commodity is manufactured / pre-packed / imported
Rule 6(1)(e): Consumer care details (name, designation, address, telephone, email)
Rule 6(1)(f): Country of origin on imported packaged goods
Rule 7 & Schedule II: Minimum font height thresholds for numerals and letters

enactments.title: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Amendment Rules, 2017
key_changes: Introduction of Unit Sale Price (USP) declarations for multi-piece packages
Increased font size requirements for net quantity and MRP declarations
Prohibition of dual MRP printing or sticker overlays

enactments.title: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Amendment Rules, 2021
key_changes: Universal Unit Sale Price (USP) in Rupees per gram/ml/number/meter
Removal of Schedule II quantity packaging restrictions allowing custom pack sizes
Mandatory date of manufacture instead of packed date for industrial commodities
